_comment: Work-only Claude Code settings, merged into ~/.claude/settings.local.json by
install.sh ONLY when a work environment is detected (Coder workspace or a
corporate MacBook). Personal machines never get these keys, so Claude Code
never tries to reach a marketplace it has no access to.
This file is tracked: the repo NAME is not sensitive, and the marketplace it
points at is INTERNAL, so knowing the name grants no access.
